name: PlantDoctor
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: This application, hosted on Hugging Face Spaces, allows users to diagnose plant diseases by uploading images of plant leaves and receive treatment recommendations. It also features an AI-powered chatbot to answer agricultural queries, leveraging a pre-trained machine learning model and the Groq API.
features: Disease Diagnosis: Upload a leaf image to identify common plant diseases using a pre-trained MobileNetV2 model.
Treatment Recommendations: Get detailed treatment suggestions based on the diagnosed disease.
Agricultural Chatbot: Ask questions about plant diseases, treatments, or general agricultural topics and receive AI-generated responses via the Grok API.
Disease Diagnosis: Powered by a MobileNetV2 model fine-tuned on the PlantVillage dataset to identify plant diseases from leaf images.
Chatbot: Utilizes the Grok API with the llama-3.3-70b-versatile model for dynamic question-answering.
